options.description: Matches what you chose today for questions on the spot: every waiting question is asked as soon as it is raised. The older cap of three per turn is dropped.
options.label: All at once (Recommended)

options.description: Blocking questions go at once and the rest are paced, at most three per turn. Fewer questions in one go, but some wait a turn or more.
options.label: Blocking first, pace the rest
